# Swap ETH — Ethereum Swap Reference

> Exchange Ethereum (ETH) for USDC, stablecoins and tokens on Ethereum and layer-2 networks through a non-custodial decentralized exchange.

## Key Facts
- Asset: ETH — native asset of Ethereum and its layer-2 networks; pays gas
- Networks: Ethereum mainnet and L2s (Arbitrum, Base, Optimism, zkSync)
- Custody: non-custodial — swaps settle through public smart contracts; wallet signs
- Approvals: buying a token with native ETH needs no approval; selling an ERC-20 for ETH needs a one-time approval
- Costs: DEX pool fee + network gas (ETH) + price impact; mainnet gas higher than L2
- Common route: ETH -> USDC / stablecoins / tokens
